newsitem.title: UK: RUGBY UNION-HOWLEY OUT FOR FOUR MONTHS.
newsitem.headline: RUGBY UNION-HOWLEY OUT FOR FOUR MONTHS.

text.p: Welsh scrum-half Rob Howley will be out of action for four months following the shoulder injury he sustained in the British Lions victory over Natal last weekend, the Welsh Rugby Union said on Friday.
The Cardiff player was admitted to hospital earlier on Friday to have a metal pin inserted in his left shoulder. The pin will be in for eight weeks and Howley is not expected to be fit until October.

The Wales player of the year with 16 international appearances for his country will miss the match against Romania on August 30. The main target for his return will be the clash with the New Zealand All Blacks at Wembley on November 15.
